title: mFRR capacity marginal prices and procured volumes per zone, direction and hour (DK1, DK2, SE3, SE4).
source: Energinet, Energi Data Service (api.energidataservice.dk); Svenska kraftnät, SVK Data Service (data.svk.se)
attribution: Source: Energinet (www.energidataservice.dk); Svenska kraftnät (SVK Data Service, data.svk.se), produced by Svk business units
transformation_notes: DK1/DK2: Energinet daily (morning) auctions, national until 2024-11-18 and the trilateral DK-SE-FI market from 2024-11-19; extra afternoon auctions (MfrrCapacityMarketExtra) and the DK2 monthly slow-reserve auctions are not included. Columns as for aFRR (source = energinet).

SE3/SE4: SVK Data Service dataset mfrr_capacity_market (marginal price EUR/MW per hour and contracted volume); only hours with Swedish procurement are published, so missing hours mean no local procurement (source = svk, demand_mw null).
note: Test fixture sliced from data/public/nordic/mfrr_capacity.parquet by scripts/research/nordic_make_fixtures.py
